def test_max_element():
    # Basic positive numbers
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3]) == 3
    assert max_element([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 124, 1, -10]) == 124

    # Negative numbers
    assert max_element([-1, -2, -3]) == -1
    assert max_element([-5, -10, -3]) == -3

    # Single element
    assert max_element([42]) == 42
    assert max_element([0]) == 0

    # Duplicates
    assert max_element([7, 7, 7]) == 7
    assert max_element([3, 3, 1, 3]) == 3

    # Max at different positions
    assert max_element([9, 1, 2]) == 9      # max first
    assert max_element([1, 9, 2]) == 9      # max middle
    assert max_element([1, 2, 9]) == 9      # max last

    # Floats
    assert max_element([1.5, 2.7, 0.3]) == 2.7
    assert max_element([-1.5, -2.7, -0.3]) == -0.3

    # Mixed ints and floats
    assert max_element([1, 2.5, 2]) == 2.5

    # All elements equal to first (m initialized to l[0])
    assert max_element([4, 1, 1, 0]) == 4

    # Booleans (True == 1)
    assert max_element([False, True, False]) is True
